title: the-tester-records-an-approved-proofs-only-build
intention: The tester records Akien's answered approval as the hollow reading of a build that wrote only its own proofs, and asks him once when no answer exists, so that build's hollow reads green on his measurement instead of measuring nothing.
why: Measured 2026-10-06: 45c168cc1ff1's build wrote only its two proofs, so its hollow skipped both as the instrument and sealed {} (0 measured), and clearance refuses hollow_nothing_measured forever: no repair of the code can give it something to revert. Akien already approved that proof change (open-728473f9b70d). The lived symptom: a ticket he said yes to cannot cross PROVED, and the only ways past are faking writes_to or weakening the gate. Ruling 8p (2026-10-06): his approval is the measurement; the tester asks for it and records it, and clearance accepts the recorded proving.
traces_to: Law 10 ('Akien said X' is a measurement), Law 8 (proof before trust; the approval is recorded on the reading, never assumed), Law 9 (a proof's claim changing is what only his head settles), RULE 1 (the question tool is reached only through its public_interface).
how: In cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py measure(): when `measured` is empty, every entry in `skipped` has why == SKIP_INSTRUMENT, and `unchanged` is empty, read cairn.tools.question.question.for_ticket(tid, root=<commons>/questions). A question passes if reseal.ruling_refusal(qid, question_root=<commons>/questions) returns None (resolved, answered by Akien) and its text names at least one skipped file. If one passes, the finding carries approved={file: qid} for every skipped file and no 'measured nothing' reason. Otherwise the reason stays 'measured nothing' and the finding carries approval_wanted=[files]. A new helper ask_for_approval(tid, files, root=None) opens one question through question.open_question (raised_by 'tester'), unless an open tester-raised question bound to tid already exists. In cli.py _hollow_run --seal: approved files are sealed as {"approved": qid}, and when approval_wanted is set the helper is called and the qid printed. New proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_records_an_approved_proofs_only_build.py.
falsifier: RED if, in a scratch commons world: (1) a build of only its instrument with an Akien-answered question bound to its ticket and naming the file is not green with approved={file: qid}; (2) the same question answered by cc, unresolved, bound to another ticket, or naming no skipped file reads green; (3) an empty run whose skips include a non-instrument skip (e.g. SKIP_OUTSIDE) reads green even with an approval; (4) ask_for_approval opens zero or more than one question across two calls; (5) 763379e32e3b's tooth 3, test_hollow.py, or test_rung_4_lifts_for_an_answered_question.py goes red.
watchme: none, because every ask and every recorded approval prints on the `cairn test --hollow --seal` surface (cairn/devices/tester/cli.py _hollow_run), and the question itself stands in Akien's inbox through the question tool (cairn question list)
children: none, because the change is two functions in one component (hollow.measure and cli._hollow_run) plus one proof
decision_lines: D1 (8p, Akien 2026-10-06, via peer akiendelllinux_cc_0): when a build's hollow can measure nothing because every writes_to file is the ticket's own proof, the tester asks Akien; his approval is the measurement (Law 10), recorded as the proving, and clearance accepts it.
D2 (8p refinement 1, agreed): the question belongs at ticketing (8i); the tester asks at measurement time only when none was answered.
D3 (8p refinement 2, agreed): open-728473f9b70d is 45c168cc1ff1's yes; the tester records it as 45c1's proving.
D4: an empty hollow for any other reason stays hollow_nothing_measured and red; 763379e32e3b tooth 3 narrows to 'proofs-only without a recorded approval stays red', cleared by 8p itself.
